lines.1: It had been about a week since student council work began.
lines.2: That alone had turned my once-ordinary days hectic.
lines.3: ...Though I was still hanging around with all the usual faces.
lines.5: Hanging out with her was still the easiest and most fun way for me to spend my time.
lines.6: I liked the Princess, but she made me nervous.
lines.7: With Crab, I never had to hide who I was.
lines.8: She was basically just an idiot, after all.
lines.9: --But precisely because she was an idiot...
lines.10: Seeing her smile could make worrying about things feel downright stupid.
lines.11: So instead of making a move on the Princess, I naturally wound up hanging out with Crab.
lines.12: Some people in class teased us with that saying about how the more two people fight, the closer they are.
lines.13: But we were nothing more than childhood friends.
lines.14: That easy relationship suited me just fine--
lines.16: 「Listen to this! You know that story on the news this week about all those escaped dogs? I'm the one who caught one of them!」
lines.17: 「What? Don't get bitten and come down with something. Please, just try not to cause us any trouble.」
lines.19: 「Anyway, Takumi's paper was recognized by the academic society, so we're having another party...」
lines.21: 「Huh? Big Bro did something impressive again?」
lines.22: 「He did. Quite a difference between him and you, isn't there, dud?」
lines.23: 「Well, I won't lecture you. Do whatever you like. If you can get into college, I'll pay for it.」
lines.26: 「So that's what happened! What do you make of THAT?!」
lines.27: For some reason, Crab rounded on me with a growl.
lines.29: 「It's amazing I haven't turned delinquent, isn't it?」
lines.30: 「...Maybe that's because you come here and vent to me.」
lines.32: 「You stayed over here last time. They weren't worried about you at all.」
lines.33: If anything, I seem to remember her parents calculating how to spend the insurance money.
lines.34: 「Tch. Maybe I should get kidnapped. Wonder how much they'd pay in ransom.」
lines.35: 「They might go as high as 998 yen.」
lines.36: 「Hey, that makes me sound like some bargain priced at under a thousand! They'd pay a little more than that.」
lines.38: 「They'd cough up ten thousand yen, at least.」
lines.39: 「...How do you feel about being cheaper than an ordinary cooking pot?」
lines.40: 「Agh, now I'm pissed off. Let's play something.」
lines.42: And so the night wore on, just like always.
